subject: [PATCH v4 10/13] mm/collapse: open-code collapse_single_pmd() in its two callers

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch removes the collapse_single_pmd() function and instead open-codes its logic in two callers, khugepaged and madvise_collapse(). The function was previously handling lock management differently for each caller, which is now handled directly by each caller. This change simplifies the code and prepares it for moving madvise_collapse() out of khugepaged.c.
